'''Jor Entel''' was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] vessel ''[[Night Wind]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Prior to the [[Demophon supernova]], Entel posed as a humanitarian, evacuating people off [[Demophon]] for a low fee. In reality he was murdering his passengers and taking their valuables. [[Enid Vahr]] fell victim to this scheme.<ref name="BE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Entel was also referred to as "O'Roark" in one section of the adventure.
